Each claim is checked as strongly as its evidence allows, and the verdict says how

re-executed the evaluator re-ran the pinned code; the check passed
re-analyzed the evaluator recomputed the numbers from released data
evidence-supported the check passed on the authors’ shipped outputs
attested the evidence is intact and its source vouches for it
unverifiable declared, but cannot be settled with what is shipped
failed a check ran and its condition was false
unassessable the evidence was never declared: a coverage note
Authors declare a validation mode: re-execute, re-analyze, inspect, or attest. Only the evaluator’s own work moves a claim up the ladder.
